iit_palakkad.NAME: IIT Palakkad
iit_palakkad.CAMPUS_HINT: — both the Ahalia (temporary) and Nila (permanent) campuses
iit_palakkad.SPECIAL: * IIT Palakkad was mentored by IIT Madras in its first years: IIT Madras faculty who taught there are `visiting` (designation e.g. `Mentor faculty from IIT Madras`), and must not be listed as regular faculty.

iit_bombay.NAME: IIT Bombay
iit_bombay.CAMPUS_HINT: ; include IDC School of Design, SJM School of Management, CTARA, CSRE, KCDH, Desai Sethi School etc.
iit_bombay.SPECIAL: * IITB-Monash Research Academy staff are not IIT Bombay faculty unless listed by an IIT Bombay unit.

iit_madras.NAME: IIT Madras
iit_madras.CAMPUS_HINT: ; include the IIT Madras Zanzibar campus (department suffix ' (Zanzibar)') and IIT Madras centres
iit_madras.SPECIAL: * Companies and tenants of the IITM Research Park are not IIT Madras faculty. IIT Madras faculty who mentored IIT Palakkad / IIT Tirupati remain IIT Madras faculty.

iit_delhi.NAME: IIT Delhi
iit_delhi.CAMPUS_HINT: ; include IIT Delhi Abu Dhabi (department suffix ' (Abu Dhabi)') and the Sonipat/Jhajjar extension campuses
iit_delhi.SPECIAL: * IIT Delhi faculty who mentored IIT Jammu remain IIT Delhi faculty.

iit_kanpur.NAME: IIT Kanpur
iit_kanpur.SPECIAL: * IIT Kanpur faculty who mentored other IITs remain IIT Kanpur faculty.

iit_hyderabad.NAME: IIT Hyderabad
iit_hyderabad.CAMPUS_HINT: (the institute was at the ODF Estate, Yeddumailaram until 2015)
iit_hyderabad.SPECIAL: * IIT Hyderabad faculty who mentored IIT Bhilai remain IIT Hyderabad faculty.

iit_bhubaneswar.NAME: IIT Bhubaneswar
iit_bhubaneswar.CAMPUS_HINT: (temporary campus at Samantapuri/Toshali Bhawan until 2015, then Argul)

iit_gandhinagar.NAME: IIT Gandhinagar
iit_gandhinagar.SPECIAL: * Note: NIPER Ahmedabad shares the Palaj address; its staff are not IIT Gandhinagar faculty.

iit_jodhpur.NAME: IIT Jodhpur
iit_jodhpur.CAMPUS_HINT: (MBM campus until ~2017, then Karwar); include iHub Drishti only if listed as IIT faculty

iit_indore.NAME: IIT Indore
iit_indore.CAMPUS_HINT: (IET-DAVV temporary campus until 2015, then Simrol); units are called 'Discipline of …' in older years

iit_mandi.NAME: IIT Mandi
iit_mandi.CAMPUS_HINT: (Mandi town transit campus until ~2015, then Kamand)

iit_bhu.NAME: IIT (BHU) Varanasi
iit_bhu.SPECIAL: * Only faculty of IIT (BHU) — not of Banaras Hindu University's Institute of Science, IMS, Institute of Agricultural Sciences etc., even where department names coincide (Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics).

iit_tirupati.NAME: IIT Tirupati
iit_tirupati.CAMPUS_HINT: (transit campus near Renigunta until ~2022, then Yerpedu)
iit_tirupati.SPECIAL: * IIT Tirupati was mentored by IIT Madras in its first years: IIT Madras faculty who only taught/mentored there are `visiting` ("Mentor faculty from IIT Madras (Y1-Y2)").

iit_ism.NAME: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad
iit_ism.SPECIAL: * The institute was 'Indian School of Mines' until 2016; faculty listed under that name 2016+ are the same institute.

iit_bhilai.NAME: IIT Bhilai
iit_bhilai.CAMPUS_HINT: (GEC Raipur transit campus until 2022, then Kutelabhata, Durg)
iit_bhilai.SPECIAL: * IIT Bhilai was mentored by IIT Hyderabad in its first years: IIT Hyderabad faculty who only taught/mentored there are `visiting` ("Mentor faculty from IIT Hyderabad (Y1-Y2)").

iit_goa.NAME: IIT Goa
iit_goa.SPECIAL: * IIT Goa was mentored by IIT Bombay in its first years: IIT Bombay faculty who only taught/mentored there are `visiting` ("Mentor faculty from IIT Bombay (Y1-Y2)").

iit_jammu.NAME: IIT Jammu
iit_jammu.SPECIAL: * IIT Jammu was mentored by IIT Delhi in its first years: IIT Delhi faculty who only taught/mentored there are `visiting` ("Mentor faculty from IIT Delhi (Y1-Y2)").

iit_dharwad.NAME: IIT Dharwad
iit_dharwad.SPECIAL: * IIT Dharwad was mentored by IIT Bombay in its first years: IIT Bombay faculty who only taught/mentored there are `visiting` ("Mentor faculty from IIT Bombay (Y1-Y2)").
